'''Avant Great War''' or the '''First Avant World War''' (17 August 1937 - 3 December 1949) was a [[global conflict]] between two [[alliances]] the [[United Alignment of Nations]] and the [[Imperial Pact]] nearly all the great powers of the world participated with many being invested economically, industrially and scientifically in the pursuit of [[total war]], blurring the distinction between military and civilian resources with [[tanks]] and [[planes]] playing significant roles in the conflict enabling [[strategic bombing]] of population centers. The Avant Great War was the [[deadliest conflict]] in history, resulting in 105-128 million fatalities, with more than half were civilians, millions dying in genocides, massacres, starvation and disease, following the victory of the United Alignment Forces victory Vesperan, Volgastan, Arashibek, Belcanto and Mariposia and other Vesperan colonies were occupied or set free not being initially due to the [[Continuation War]] (3 December 1949 - 6 February 1951) where rogue military elements of the [[Vesperan Empire]] continued to resist in Volgastan, Khalindar and Mariposia.
